title: GTA 6 Police Remember Your Car And Clothes
sources: Shacknews: GTA 6 goes back to a six-star Wanted Level system
GamesRadar / Games.gg: wanted levels and the Heat system explained (Heat tracks what police know)
Beebom, Gfinity, Dexerto: wanted system explainers (police work from clothing, vehicle, description; CCTV)
IBTimes UK: GTA 6 police system, erase evidence and hide vehicles instead of waiting out a timer
All preview-based; whole-map search at max wanted is reported, sources differ

lines.text: GTA 5 players: your old trick to lose the cops won't work in GTA 6!
In GTA 5, you could just hide and wait out the stars.
But previews say GTA 6 police remember what they actually saw:
The stars show the chase, but a separate Heat level tracks what police know about you.
So changing your clothes or your car can cool the Heat, even while the stars stay on!
And at six stars, reports say police search the whole map.
All of this comes from previews, so reviews will tell us more.
Which GTA 5 trick will you miss most? Comment it!
